description: Check an auto, homeowners, renters, or rental-property policy against the underlying liability requirements stated in a specific umbrella quote. Supply requirements from that quote, not assumed carrier minimums. Missing current limits stay unknown. Returns each required increase separately; it does not determine claim payouts or eligibility.

Send only fields for the chosen structure.
